note: cues = the subtitle lines, in order; joined with spaces they are the narration exactly as scripted. say = the same sentence spelled the way the voice should pronounce it (numbers, aircraft IDs and the product name: the voice engine reads "Acumain" as ACK-yoo-main, one word; "AcuMain" comes out as two words).
